rv.q: Audiences looking for something less bombastic will adore this warm hug of a show.
Musical Theatre West’s Little Women makes it well worth the wait.
MAD's production succeeds because it honors the warmth and enduring humanity of its source material.
With a soaring score and poignant lyrics, Little Women captures the hope, love, and personal sacrifice that shape the March sisters' journey.

cn.t: Critics widely embrace this musical adaptation of Alcott's classic, praising its soaring score and poignant storytelling. The production earns strong marks for capturing the timeless heart of the March sisters' journey.
